requirements.reason: Some public function names from R are retained, but HIGHLEVEL=5 differs from frozen A's value of 10, and Setpoint/State types and power-function signatures differ. Because R explicitly references A, this is judged partial; Direct generation's lack of access to A is separately disclosed.
Only standard C math, memory, and integer headers are used, and the algorithm is deterministic.
The queues are bounded and most ages use tick, but timed reception completely ignores timeoutMs.
Fusion and attitude initialization guard against repetition; repeated Commander and CRTP initialization erases active state.
Throughout the complete implementation, output pointers are checked for NULL before writes.
Normalization, voltage ratios, and sample counts all have zero-value protection.
The complete production C file does not define main.
t/r/p/y and motor outputs use int32_t to store mixing intermediates.
It clamps at positive/negative INT16_MAX and directly converts in-range values.
Two while loops support multiple turns; strict comparisons preserve plus or minus 180 degrees.
The first call sets the identity quaternion and clears integrals; the initialization flag protects running state.
It returns the actual sensfusionInitDone value.
It defines 1 kHz and dividers and implements estimation at 250/100 Hz, but actual 500 Hz control/power and 100 Hz radio scheduling are missing.
Real-time, resource, physical-device, or statistical properties require execution, build artifacts, or hardware measurements; code reading alone cannot establish compliance.
Acceleration/gyroscope/magnetometer and barometer/temperature inputs are retained, without substituting device models.
Angular rates convert to radians, dt integrates the quaternion, and normalization follows.
twoKp=.8, twoKi=.002, and three-axis integral-feedback paths exist.
A clearing branch exists, but twoKi is a function-local constant of .002 and cannot actually be configured to 0.
The configuration is forced to 0, and the function contains only Mahony, without a Madgwick gradient/beta branch.
All-zero acceleration skips correction while gyroscope integration still executes.
Calibration occurs only on the first valid update, but raw acceleration is normalized first, so baseZacc loses the actual projection magnitude.
The specified gravity-direction formulas are computed from the current quaternion.
It reads the current quaternion at the time of the call and outputs RPY in degrees.
The value is clamped to [-1,1] before asinf.
It returns all four current global components.
The current gravity direction is dotted with the input acceleration.
Projection minus baseZacc.
It uses 0x5f3759df and one Newton iteration.
The four sign patterns, roll/2, and pitch/2 are correct, without premature clamping.
Quarter thrust, the 0.707106781 arm length, and X-frame signs are correct; negative force is set to zero.
Zero arm length/torque ratio is first replaced with nonzero defaults, so the corresponding components do not become zero as required.
It uses the .0397/.005964 defaults and a force-to-PWM square-root mapping, rather than multiplying newtons directly by 65535.
Each output is clamped to [0,1] before conversion to the PWM range.
All three modes are routed exactly; unknown modes do not write output.
A strict greater-than comparison triggers a common excess reduction; all four outputs subtract the same reduction, and capped is returned.
Signed subtraction is followed by an idle clamp, so negative values do not wrap as unsigned values.
It implements old+.01*(supply-old).
Invalid actual voltage preserves the original value; the voltage ratio is rounded and clamped to PWM.
Mixing/force/PWM boundaries exist, but there is no physical PWM output-adapter path.
The control task only submits a high-level setpoint; it does not implement clearing all four physical outputs under lock/emergency stop.
It accepts a voltage parameter but lacks a sampling/conversion path from the ADC environment input into the normal control loop.
The configurable three-level policy of low-voltage warning, thrust limiting, and controlled landing is not implemented.
The requirements omit necessary parameters or contain conflicting wording; clarify a common contract first, rather than deriving it from the candidate implementation.
All six PIDs are initialized, with a flag guarding repeated initialization.
All three rate outputs pass through saturateSignedInt16.
roll/pitch reset=false，yaw reset=true。
The full reset sets current attitude and clears all six PIDs; a single-axis reset clears only the specified attitude PID.
Rate-mode yaw accumulates using attitudeUpdateDt.
There is no yawMaxDelta input or branch limiting yaw relative to current yaw.
Absolute yaw uses the set value; quaternion mode converts the current target quaternion to obtain yaw.
Roll/pitch rate modes take the rate directly and clear the corresponding attitude PID.
When z is enabled, thrust is computed from position/velocity error rather than degenerating to a direct copy of the manual value.
An explicit switch injects deterministic position-control thrust.
It uses manual roll/pitch from the setpoint, satisfying the manual-attitude path when x/y are disabled.
All four control quantities are cleared, attitude is reset, and yaw is synchronized, but position-PID/filter reset is missing.
pitchActual is negative gyro.y.
The Legacy actuator yaw output is negated.
DISABLE sets the lock; raw=0 releases it.
Outside AltHold, a lock or a value below 1000 produces 0; otherwise, the upper limit is 60000.
AltHold's z velocity mode, zero direct thrust, and vertical-velocity formula are correct.
modeSet and disabling z on exit exist, but entry resets roll/pitch attitude PIDs instead of the position PID/filter.
PosHold precedes default, uses positive pitch/30 and roll/30, and clears attitude.
PosSet requires nonzero raw input; absolute coordinates, modes, and clearing thrust are correct.
Only roll/pitch ANGLE is implemented; there is no RATE configuration branch.
Only yaw RATE with negative input is implemented; there is no ANGLE configuration branch.
PLUS rotation/X preservation exist, but CAREFREE only clears thrust/returns without distinguishable error state.
Standard two-dimensional rotation after radians conversion.

metric: coverage of 141 statically reviewable requirement leaves; 4 preclassified leaves unassessed
note: All original C/H read; actual R+D prompt bound. R explicitly requires frozen A; actual mismatch evaluated in R001 even though A was not supplied to Direct. No execution, code edits, external calls, old score reuse or human review claim.

api.role: reviewer reference only; not supplied to Direct-LLM

scope_review_policy: R+D host-equivalent scope. Direct receives no A, but R expressly references frozen A; R001 assesses actual contract match and discloses input asymmetry. Functional leaves do not invent extra interface obligations. Pure build failures do not zero functionality.

release_export.language: Original Chinese evidence/rationales retained; no semantic translation.
release_export.preservation: Initial verdicts, reasons, historical rates and human-review flags retained. Path anonymization and export metadata do not constitute a new review.
release_export.current_aggregation: (fully_covered + partially_covered) / preclassified static denominator; no fractional weighting of partial items.
release_export.evidence_line_numbers: Original candidate lines; transformed candidate comments, where used, retain separately recorded original and distributed hashes.
